```sql
SELECT AVG(cr.points) 
FROM main."constructorResults" cr
JOIN main."races" r ON cr."raceId" = r."raceId"
JOIN main."constructors" c ON cr."constructorId" = c."constructorId"
WHERE c."constructorRef" = 'brawn'
  AND r."year" = 2010
  AND r."date" <= '2010-07-01'
```
